test_cases.description: Schema migration adds group_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' column to the jobs table, and existing rows have group_key set to empty string.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with the jobs table from the durable_job_queue spec (spec 10) without the group_key column
At least one existing job row is present in the jobs table
test_cases.input: Run the merge_operations schema migration against the existing jobs table
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: run_migration(); col = db.column_info('jobs', 'group_key'); assert col.type == 'TEXT'; assert col.not_null == true; assert col.default_value == ''; rows = db.query('SELECT group_key FROM jobs'); for row in rows: assert row.group_key == ''

test_cases.description: Enqueuing a job with a non-empty Group value stores that value in the group_key column of the inserted job row.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with the migrated jobs table including group_key column
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: job_id = queue.Enqueue(EnqueueParams{Type:'merge', Key:'ws1:main:feature/a', Group:'ws1:main', Payload:'{}'}); row = db.query('SELECT group_key FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); assert row.group_key == 'ws1:main'

test_cases.description: Enqueuing a job without a Group field stores an empty string in group_key, preserving existing dedup behavior.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with the migrated jobs table including group_key column
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: job_id = queue.Enqueue(EnqueueParams{Type:'clone', Key:'ws1:clone', Payload:'{}'}); row = db.query('SELECT group_key FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); assert row.group_key == ''

test_cases.description: Worker dispatch query uses CASE WHEN group_key != '' THEN group_key ELSE key END as the serialization key, blocking a second job of the same type and group_key while one is running.
preconditions: SQLite database has two merge jobs with type='merge', group_key='ws1:main', status='queued'
test_cases.input: Worker attempts to dispatch both jobs simultaneously
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: insert_job(type='merge', key='ws1:main:feature/a', group_key='ws1:main', status='queued'); insert_job(type='merge', key='ws1:main:feature/b', group_key='ws1:main', status='queued'); worker.dispatch(); running = db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE type=? AND group_key=? AND status=?', 'merge', 'ws1:main', 'running'); assert running.count == 1; queued = db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE type=? AND group_key=? AND status=?', 'merge', 'ws1:main', 'queued'); assert queued.count == 1

test_cases.description: Existing job types without group_key continue to serialize by (type, key) with no behavioral change after the migration.
preconditions: SQLite database has two jobs with type='clone', key='ws1:clone', group_key='', status='queued'
test_cases.input: Worker attempts to dispatch both clone jobs
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: insert_job(type='clone', key='ws1:clone', group_key='', status='queued'); insert_job(type='clone', key='ws1:clone', group_key='', status='queued'); worker.dispatch(); running = db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE type=? AND key=? AND status=?', 'clone', 'ws1:clone', 'running'); assert running.count == 1

test_cases.description: The hub server registers a job handler for type 'merge' with the durable job queue before serving the first request.
preconditions: Hub server is configured with a valid SQLite database
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: server = start_hub_server(); registered_types = queue.registered_job_types(); assert 'merge' in registered_types; assert server.is_ready_to_serve()

test_cases.description: Every merge job is enqueued with Key='<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>:<source_ref>' and Group='<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>'.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with migrated jobs table
Durable job queue is initialized with merge handler registered
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: job_id = enqueue_merge_job(workspace_slug='my-ws', target_branch='main', source_ref='feature/x', submitted_by='alice'); row = db.query('SELECT key, group_key FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); assert row.key == 'my-ws:main:feature/x'; assert row.group_key == 'my-ws:main'

test_cases.description: When a merge job is enqueued via an API key, submitted_by in the job payload equals the API key owner's username from AuthInfo.
preconditions: Hub server is running with merge handler registered
AuthInfo is populated with username='alice' from an API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: auth_info = AuthInfo{Username: 'alice', AuthMethod: 'api_key'}; job_id = enqueue_merge_job_with_auth(auth_info, workspace_slug='ws1', target_branch='main', source_ref='feature/a'); row = db.query('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); payload = json_parse(row.payload); assert payload.submitted_by == 'alice'

test_cases.description: When a merge job is enqueued via an admin token, submitted_by in the job payload is the literal string 'admin'.
preconditions: Hub server is running with merge handler registered
Request is authenticated with an admin token
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: auth_info = AuthInfo{AuthMethod: 'admin_token'}; job_id = enqueue_merge_job_with_auth(auth_info, workspace_slug='ws1', target_branch='main', source_ref='feature/a'); row = db.query('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); payload = json_parse(row.payload); assert payload.submitted_by == 'admin'

test_cases.description: When a merge job is enqueued via a PAT, submitted_by in the job payload equals the PAT owner's username from AuthInfo.
preconditions: Hub server is running with merge handler registered
AuthInfo is populated with PAT owner username='bob'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: auth_info = AuthInfo{Username: 'bob', AuthMethod: 'pat'}; job_id = enqueue_merge_job_with_auth(auth_info, workspace_slug='ws1', target_branch='main', source_ref='feature/a'); row = db.query('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id = ?', job_id); payload = json_parse(row.payload); assert payload.submitted_by == 'bob'

test_cases.description: When the dry-run conflict check detects conflicts, the merge handler returns WouldConflict as a permanent error with conflict_files, and the job transitions to failed status.
preconditions: git merge-tree --write-tree is mocked to return non-zero exit code with conflict file list ['src/main.go']
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result, err = merge_handler.pre_check(workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/conflict'); assert err != nil; assert err.type == WouldConflict; assert err.is_permanent == true; assert err.conflict_files == ['src/main.go']; assert working_tree_is_clean('ws1')

test_cases.description: When the source branch is already integrated into the target, the merge handler returns AlreadyMerged and marks the job as completed without performing any git operations.
preconditions: Source branch commits are already reachable from target branch HEAD
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result, err = merge_handler.pre_check(workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/already-merged'); assert err == nil; assert result.reason == AlreadyMerged; assert result.is_success == true; assert no_git_operations_performed()

test_cases.description: When the source branch has no commits ahead of the target, the merge handler returns BranchNotReady as a retryable error.
preconditions: Source branch HEAD is identical to or behind target branch HEAD
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result, err = merge_handler.pre_check(workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/not-ready'); assert err != nil; assert err.type == BranchNotReady; assert err.is_retryable == true; assert no_git_operations_performed()

test_cases.description: The merge handler invokes GitRunner with 'git merge-tree --write-tree <target-head> <source-branch-head>' in the workspace trunk directory during the pre-check phase.
preconditions: GitRunner is available and instrumented to record invocations
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: runner = instrumented_git_runner(); merge_handler.run_dry_run_check(runner, workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/a'); invocations = runner.get_invocations(); assert len(invocations) == 1; assert invocations[0].args == ['merge-tree', '--write-tree', 'aaa111', 'bbb222']; assert invocations[0].cwd == '<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'

test_cases.description: When git merge-tree --write-tree exits with a conflict exit code, the handler parses conflict_files and returns WouldConflict as a permanent error, leaving the working tree unmodified.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked to return exit code 1 with output listing 'src/foo.go' as conflicting
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = merge_handler.run_dry_run_check(mocked_runner_with_conflict(['src/foo.go']), workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/conflict'); assert err != nil; assert err.reason == WouldConflict; assert err.is_permanent == true; assert err.conflict_files == ['src/foo.go']; assert working_tree_is_clean('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/')

test_cases.description: When git merge-tree --write-tree exits with code 0, the merge handler proceeds to the fetch step without error.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked to return exit code 0 (no conflicts)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = merge_handler.run_dry_run_check(mocked_runner_no_conflict(), workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/clean'); assert err == nil; assert merge_handler.next_step_is_fetch()

test_cases.description: After the pre-check passes, the merge handler fetches the latest target branch state from the upstream remote via go-git using resolveCloneAuth credentials.
preconditions: go-git Repository.Fetch is instrumented to record calls
resolveCloneAuth returns valid credentials for the workspace
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: repo = instrumented_go_git_repo('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'); merge_handler.run_fetch_step(repo, workspace='ws1', target='main'); assert repo.fetch_was_called(); assert repo.fetch_options.auth == resolve_clone_auth('ws1'); assert repo.fetch_error == nil

test_cases.description: The merge handler captures the pre-rebase SHA of the source branch before invoking GitRunner to run 'git rebase <target-ref>' in the workspace trunk directory.
preconditions: GitRunner is instrumented to record invocations
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: runner = instrumented_git_runner(); pre_sha, err = merge_handler.run_rebase_step(runner, workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/a'); assert pre_sha == 'abc123def456abc123def456abc123def456abc1'; assert runner.invocations[0].args == ['rebase', 'main']; assert runner.invocations[0].cwd == '<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'

test_cases.description: When CHECK_COMMAND is set, the merge handler executes it via 'sh -c <CHECK_COMMAND>' in the workspace trunk directory with MERGE_TARGET, MERGE_SOURCE, and WORKSPACE_SLUG injected, enforcing a 10-minute timeout.
preconditions: CHECK_COMMAND workspace variable is set to 'make test'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: executor = instrumented_command_executor(); merge_handler.run_check_step(executor, workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/a', check_cmd='make test'); call = executor.last_call(); assert call.command == ['sh', '-c', 'make test']; assert call.cwd == '<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'; assert call.env['MERGE_TARGET'] == 'main'; assert call.env['MERGE_SOURCE'] == 'feature/a'; assert call.env['WORKSPACE_SLUG'] == 'ws1'; assert call.timeout_seconds == 600

test_cases.description: When CHECK_COMMAND is not set, the merge handler skips the check step and proceeds directly to the ref update step.
preconditions: CHECK_COMMAND workspace variable is not set for workspace 'ws1'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: executor = instrumented_command_executor(); merge_handler.run_check_step(executor, workspace='ws1', target='main', source='feature/a', check_cmd=nil); assert executor.call_count() == 0; assert merge_handler.next_step_is_ref_update()

test_cases.description: After the check command exits 0 (or is skipped), the merge handler updates the target branch ref to the rebased source HEAD via go-git reference update (local only, no remote push).
preconditions: Rebase has completed; rebased HEAD SHA is 'newsha123'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: repo = instrumented_go_git_repo('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'); merge_handler.run_ref_update_step(repo, target='main', new_sha='newsha123'); ref = repo.storer.reference('refs/heads/main'); assert ref.hash == 'newsha123'; assert repo.push_was_not_called()

test_cases.description: After the target branch ref update succeeds, the merge handler deletes the source branch ref from the local repository via go-git reference deletion.
preconditions: Target branch ref has been updated successfully
Source branch 'feature/a' ref exists in the repository
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: repo = go_git_open('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/ws1/trunk/'); merge_handler.run_delete_source_step(repo, source='feature/a'); ref, err = repo.storer.reference('refs/heads/feature/a'); assert err == ErrReferenceNotFound

test_cases.description: After source branch deletion succeeds, the merge handler returns success with base_sha (pre-merge target HEAD) and merged_sha (new target HEAD) as 40-char hex SHAs.
preconditions: All merge steps have completed successfully
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result, err = merge_handler.finalize(base_sha='base000sha000base000sha000base000sha0001', merged_sha='merged1sha1merged1sha1merged1sha1merged1'); assert err == nil; assert len(result.base_sha) == 40; assert len(result.merged_sha) == 40; assert result.base_sha == 'base000sha000base000sha000base000sha0001'; assert result.merged_sha == 'merged1sha1merged1sha1merged1sha1merged1'

test_cases.description: The branch rebase operation invokes GitRunner with 'git rebase <target-ref>' on the source branch and returns the new branch HEAD SHA on success.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked to return exit code 0 and new HEAD SHA 'newhead123'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: new_sha, err = rebase_operation(runner=mocked_runner_success('newhead123'), workspace='ws1', source='feature/a', target='main'); assert err == nil; assert new_sha == 'newhead123'; assert mocked_runner.last_args() == ['rebase', 'main']

test_cases.description: When the rebase encounters conflicts, the branch rebase operation runs 'git rebase --abort' and returns a RebaseConflictError with conflict_files; the branch is left in its pre-rebase state.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked to return a conflict exit code with conflict_files=['src/a.go']
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: runner = mocked_runner_conflict(['src/a.go']); new_sha, err = rebase_operation(runner=runner, workspace='ws1', source='feature/a', target='main'); assert new_sha == ''; assert err.type == RebaseConflictError; assert err.conflict_files == ['src/a.go']; assert runner.abort_was_called()

test_cases.description: The batch rebase operation rebases each branch sequentially, aborts and records conflicts for failing branches, and continues with remaining branches, returning a per-branch result list.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked: feature/a succeeds, feature/b conflicts, feature/c succeeds
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: results = batch_rebase(workspace='ws1', target='main', branches=['feature/a','feature/b','feature/c']); assert len(results) == 3; assert results[0].branch == 'feature/a' and results[0].status == 'ok' and results[0].new_head != ''; assert results[1].branch == 'feature/b' and results[1].status == 'conflict' and len(results[1].conflict_files) > 0; assert results[2].branch == 'feature/c' and results[2].status == 'ok' and results[2].new_head != ''

test_cases.description: A conflict on one branch during batch rebase does not prevent rebasing of subsequent branches; all branches appear in the result list.
preconditions: GitRunner is mocked: feature/a conflicts, feature/b succeeds, feature/c succeeds
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: results = batch_rebase(workspace='ws1', target='main', branches=['feature/a','feature/b','feature/c']); branch_names = [r.branch for r in results]; assert 'feature/a' in branch_names; assert 'feature/b' in branch_names; assert 'feature/c' in branch_names; assert len(results) == 3

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges with valid target_branch and source_ref enqueues a merge job and returns HTTP 202 with the queued job record.
preconditions: Branches 'main' and 'feature/a' exist in the workspace repository
Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', body={target_branch:'main', source_ref:'feature/a'}, auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 202; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert is_valid_uuid(body.id); assert body.status == 'queued'; assert body.workspace_slug == 'ws1'; assert body.target_branch == 'main'; assert body.source_ref == 'feature/a'; assert body.submitted_by != ''

test_cases.description: Submitting a duplicate merge job for the same source_ref and target_branch in the same workspace returns HTTP 409.
preconditions: A merge job for target_branch='main', source_ref='feature/a' in workspace 'ws1' is already queued or running
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', body={target_branch:'main', source_ref:'feature/a'}, auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 409; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert body.error != ''

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges with missing target_branch or source_ref returns HTTP 400 indicating which field is missing.
preconditions: Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', body={target_branch:'main'}, auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 400; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert 'source_ref' in body.error

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges for a non-existent workspace returns HTTP 404.
preconditions: Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/nonexistent/merges', body={target_branch:'main', source_ref:'feature/a'}, auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 404; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert body.error != ''

preconditions: Workspace 'ws1' exists but is in archived status
Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', body={target_branch:'main', source_ref:'feature/a'}, auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 400; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert 'not active' in body.error.to_lower()

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges when source or target branch does not exist in the workspace repository returns HTTP 400 identifying the missing branch.
preconditions: Workspace 'ws1' exists, is active, and clone is ready
Branch 'main' exists but 'feature/nonexistent' does not exist in the workspace repository
Caller is authenticated with a valid API key

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges called by a PAT without merges:write scope returns HTTP 403.
preconditions: Caller is authenticated with a PAT that has only merges:read scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', body={target_branch:'main', source_ref:'feature/a'}, auth=pat_read_only); assert resp.status == 403; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert body.error != ''

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of merge job records scoped to the workspace.
preconditions: Two merge jobs exist for workspace 'ws1'
Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_get('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges', auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 200; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert is_array(body); assert len(body) == 2; for item in body: assert item.workspace_slug == 'ws1'; assert item.id != ''; assert item.status in ['queued','running','completed','failed','dead_letter','cancelled']

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id returns HTTP 200 with the merge job record for a valid job ID, or HTTP 404 if the job does not exist.
preconditions: Merge job with id='job-uuid-1' exists for workspace 'ws1'
Caller is authenticated with a valid API key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_get('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges/job-uuid-1', auth=api_key); assert resp.status == 200; body = json_parse(resp.body); assert body.id == 'job-uuid-1'; assert body.workspace_slug == 'ws1'; resp404 = http_get('/api/v1/workspaces/ws1/merges/nonexistent-id', auth=api_key); assert resp404.status == 404

test_cases.description: Merge REST API response serialization projects job queue records into merge response objects with all required fields, using null for missing optional fields.
preconditions: A job queue record exists for a queued merge job with payload containing workspace_slug, target_branch, source_ref, submitted_by
Job result is null (job not yet completed)

property_tests.description: For any workspace and target branch, at most one merge job with the matching group_key is in running status at any given time.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate 2-10 merge jobs with the same workspace_slug and target_branch (same group_key) but different source_refs; insert them all as queued; run the worker dispatch loop repeatedly
property_tests.invariant_check: after each dispatch cycle, query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE type='merge' AND group_key=? AND status='running'; assert count <= 1

property_tests.description: For any workspace, target_branch, and source_ref triple, at most one non-terminal job with the matching key exists in the jobs table at any time.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate 2-5 concurrent enqueue calls with the same workspace_slug, target_branch, and source_ref; use goroutines to simulate concurrent submission
property_tests.invariant_check: after all enqueue calls complete, query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE type='merge' AND key=? AND status NOT IN ('completed','failed','dead_letter','cancelled'); assert count <= 1

property_tests.description: After any merge handler execution (success or failure), the workspace trunk directory contains no uncommitted rebase state or partial merge artifacts.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample merge scenarios: (a) clean merge, (b) dry-run conflict, (c) rebase conflict, (d) check command failure, (e) check command timeout; run each scenario against a real workspace clone
property_tests.invariant_check: after merge_handler.execute() returns (any return value), run git_runner('git status --porcelain') in <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/; assert output is empty and git_runner('git rebase --show-current-patch') returns error (no rebase in progress)

property_tests.description: The pre-rebase SHA of the source branch is always captured before any GitRunner invocation that modifies the branch.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Instrument GitRunner to record the order of invocations and the SHA captured; run merge handler with various inputs including conflict and success scenarios
property_tests.invariant_check: assert pre_rebase_sha is captured (non-empty) before the first GitRunner call with 'rebase' in its arguments; assert pre_rebase_sha equals the source branch HEAD SHA at the time of capture

property_tests.description: The source branch ref is deleted if and only if the target branch ref update has already succeeded.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Run merge handler scenarios: (a) ref update succeeds then delete, (b) ref update fails (mocked lock error), (c) delete step fails after successful ref update
property_tests.invariant_check: if source_branch_deleted then assert target_ref_was_updated_first; if target_ref_update_failed then assert source_branch_still_exists

property_tests.description: The batch rebase result list always contains exactly N entries for N input branches, regardless of individual branch failures.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random lists of 1-20 branch names; randomly assign each branch to succeed, conflict, or not-exist; run batch_rebase with each list
property_tests.invariant_check: assert len(results) == len(input_branches); assert set(r.branch for r in results) == set(input_branches)

property_tests.description: For any job type that does not set group_key, the effective serialization key equals the job's key column value, preserving pre-extension behavior.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate job types other than 'merge' (e.g. 'clone', 'sync') with various key values and empty group_key; insert multiple jobs with the same type and key
property_tests.invariant_check: evaluate CASE WHEN group_key != '' THEN group_key ELSE key END for each row; assert result equals key when group_key is empty; run worker dispatch and assert at most one job per (type, key) runs simultaneously

property_tests.description: When the source branch is already integrated into the target, the merge handler always returns success without modifying any git state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate workspace clones where source branch HEAD is reachable from target branch HEAD (already merged); run merge_handler.pre_check() for each
property_tests.invariant_check: assert err == nil and result.reason == AlreadyMerged; capture git log --oneline before and after; assert no new commits or ref changes occurred

edge_case_tests.description: When the check command exits with non-zero, the handler runs 'git checkout <source-branch> && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>' to restore the source branch, then returns a permanent error with check output.

go-git reference update and branch deletion
mockable: upstream remote git server (for fetch step)

Source branch 'feature/agent-1' ref no longer exists in the workspace repository

'afc merge status my-workspace <job-id>' returns status='completed' with base_sha and merged_sha

real_components: GitRunner (spec 11) for rebase, checkout, and reset --hard
workspace variables system (spec 07) for CHECK_COMMAND retrieval
mockable: upstream remote git server (for fetch step)
CHECK_COMMAND subprocess (mocked to exit 1 with known output)
expected_effects: Job transitions from 'running' to 'failed'
Source branch ref points to the pre-rebase SHA (rollback succeeded)
Working tree at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ is clean (no uncommitted changes)
Target branch ref is unchanged (not advanced)
Source branch ref still exists (not deleted)
Job error field contains the check command output
GET /merges/:id returns status='failed' with check_output populated
